contextMenu.acceptIAHint: Fills all months of each product with the volume suggested by the AI model. Shows preview before applying.
contextMenu.fillAvg3Hint: Fills all months with the average sales of the last 3 months. Uniform value per product.

contextMenu.revertChangesHint: Restores all values in this family to the cycle's initial opening state. Shows a preview before applying.
